authority: Independent tester; frozen step0043 spec, public types and signatures only
case_generation: Cartesian product, exactly one mandatory executable capability per domain. Documentation-only asserts capability in README, irrelevant candidate describes astronomy, zero candidates records completed query with zero results.

requirements.recipe: execute recipe substitutions with allergy constraints

expected: No input supplies executable implementation or identified execution. No capability/operation execution proof or FORK allowed. Preserve uncertainty and expose next verification action with acceptance.

false_proof.case_failure: Any PROVEN assessed capability or local operation, FORK decision, or plan action PROVEN

correct_abstention.case_success: No false proof; assessments have no admissible implementation proof and selector does not FORK

actionable_plan.case_success: Nonempty scoped plan, at least one action and each unresolved action links known requirement, has NextAction and Acceptance; gap represented by non-PROVEN status

reproducibility: Pure literal inputs; real AssessEvidence, DecideReuse, BuildInvestigationPlan; repeat identical inputs and compare complete outputs
limits: Synthetic public regression screen only. Not held-out utility benchmark, external validity study, ecosystem recall measurement, or human usefulness validation. No positive implementation/execution sensitivity measured by this G set. Frozen tests separately include local positive read controls.
